summary: Completed testing of Legal Notepad, CourtListener search, and PDF export features. Found and fixed 1 bug: route ordering issue where /api/export/notepad/all/pdf was incorrectly matching as {entry_id} parameter. All 18 backend tests pass, all frontend UI flows working correctly.
passed_tests: Legal Notepad - Create new note manually (POST /api/notepad)
Legal Notepad - View/expand note content in UI
Legal Notepad - Export single note to PDF (GET /api/export/notepad/{id}/pdf)
Legal Notepad - Export all notes to PDF (GET /api/export/notepad/all/pdf)
Law Library - 'Save to Notepad' button saves state law (POST /api/notepad/save-from-library)
Law Library - Texas law content verified (DFPS, Family Code references)
Court Opinions - Search with court filter works (?court=ca9)
Court Opinions - Save case to notepad (POST /api/notepad/save-from-courtlistener)
Court Opinions - Saved case content properly formatted
PDF Export - Single note download works (returns valid PDF)
PDF Export - All notes download works (returns valid PDF)

bugs_fixed.issue: Route ordering bug - /api/export/notepad/all/pdf was matching /{entry_id}/pdf route
bugs_fixed.fix: Moved export_all_notes_to_pdf route definition BEFORE export_notepad_to_pdf route
bugs_fixed.root_cause: FastAPI matches routes in definition order. 'all' was being captured as entry_id parameter, causing 404 'Note not found' error

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering is critical in FastAPI - more specific routes must come before parameterized routes
All notepad CRUD operations working correctly with proper user_id filtering
CourtListener API integration working - returns 20 results per search
PDF generation using reportlab library working correctly with emoji handling
All frontend data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: Created test notes during pytest which are cleaned up. User lawtest@test.com has existing notes from previous tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Legal Notepad and PDF export features fully functional. Route ordering bug fixed - /api/export/notepad/all/pdf now correctly defined before /{entry_id}/pdf. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_notepad_pdf_export.py covers all CRUD operations, save-from-library, save-from-courtlistener, and PDF export features. CourtListener search returns real results from the API.
